description: Runtime JSONL: one source/candidate field per line. Evaluation labels must be in a separate file, never included in runtime input.

example.source_text: Rule R1. Written comments close October 31, 2026, if a hearing is requested.

candidate.claim: Written comments for Rule R1 close October 31, 2026 if a hearing is requested.

evidence.quote: Written comments close October 31, 2026, if a hearing is requested.

offsets: Zero-based Unicode code point offsets in source_text, half-open [start,end). Must satisfy source_text[start:end] == quote exactly. No normalization.
optional_source_metadata: source_id and source_locator strings only; evidence may include locator string. These are metadata, not substitute evidence.
abstention: insufficient is explicit abstention on a dimension; invalid citations block all dimensions. No whole-document trust score.
candidate_value_type: bounded JSON: string, null, finite number, boolean, list or object (<=4 nested levels, <=16 elements per container, <=4000 serialized UTF-8 bytes). Null is candidate abstention; compound semantics are judged against actual JSON, never flattened.
evidence_empty: Allowed, but deterministic missing_evidence abstains without provider call.
